package.description: Receive content from Apple devices on Windows through the AirPrint workflow.

en-US.description: Receive content from Apple devices on Windows through the AirPrint workflow.
en-US.longDescription: Archura Windrop is a Windows tray application that presents the PC as an AirPrint destination, receives documents from iPhone, iPad, and macOS over the local network, and saves or copies useful output to the Windows clipboard.
en-US.name: Archura Windrop
